summary: lightclient 提交并合并 EIP-8141 修改，对所有签名在 calldata 费用之外每条加收 100 gas，防止大量空 ARBITRARY 签名条目少付费，作为 MAX_SIGNATURES 上限方案的替代。此前提交的批准效果交易级语义和 frame 交易收据编码也合并。forshtat 把 ERC-1613 Gas Station Network 从 Stagnant 移回 Draft，理由是 Polygon 上仍有 Polymarket 等在用。Aztec Alpha V5 把客户端证明降到消费级笔记本约 2.5 秒。

items.title: EIP-8141：对每个任意签名条目收费
items.note: （lightclient）提交并合并，作为 #11935 的替代：为避免大量空的 `ARBITRARY` 签名条目没有被公平计费，对所有签名在常规 calldata 费用之外每条加收固定 100 gas。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: charge for each arbitrary sig entry
items.note_en: (lightclient), submitted and merged as an alternative to #11935: to keep large numbers of empty `ARBITRARY` signature entries from being under-charged, a flat 100 gas per entry is added on top of regular calldata costs for all signatures.

items.title: ERC-1613：移至 Draft
items.note: （forshtat）合并。他在清理旧的 Stagnant ERC，但认为 GSN 虽多年未开发，仍在包括 Polygon 在内的链上使用，Polymarket 是用户之一，撤回没有意义。论坛讨论 23:40。
items.note_en: (forshtat), merged. He is withdrawing old stagnant ERCs, but argues that although GSN has not been developed for years, it is still used on chains including Polygon, where Polymarket is among its users, so withdrawing it makes no sense. Forum discussion, 23:40.

summary_en: lightclient submitted and merged an EIP-8141 change that adds a flat 100 gas per signature on top of calldata costs, so large numbers of empty ARBITRARY signature entries cannot underpay; it is an alternative to the MAX_SIGNATURES cap. The previously submitted transaction-scoped approval semantics and frame transaction receipt encoding were also merged. forshtat moved ERC-1613 Gas Station Network from Stagnant back to Draft because it is still used on Polygon, including by Polymarket. Aztec Alpha V5 brings client-side proving down to about 2.5 seconds on a consumer laptop.
